breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error by applying thin airfoil theory (Cl = 2πα) at 20 degrees angle of attack. It does not acknowledge that this linear model is invalid at such a high angle due to stall/nonlinear effects, does not suggest reducing the angle to a small value (e.g., 5 degrees), and does not recommend using nonlinear models or experimental data for 20 degrees. The inconsistency is entirely unresolved.
